overall_strategy_summary: Fidelity International is a London-based global asset manager (separate from US Fidelity Investments). Active in tokenization via JPMorgan TCN for collateral, APAC digital propositions, and Sygnum partnership. Broader strategy focuses on active management, multi-asset solutions, retirement, and sustainable investing. Technology focuses on distribution platforms, data analytics, and client experience. Benefits from broader Fidelity ecosystem but operates independently.

business_segments.name: Investment Management
business_segments.description: Active management across equities, fixed income, multi-asset, alternatives. ~$800B AUM. Strong Asia-Pacific presence.

business_segments.name: Solutions & Multi-Asset
business_segments.description: Target date funds, model portfolios, retirement solutions, outsourced CIO services.

business_segments.name: Institutional
business_segments.description: Pension funds, sovereign wealth, insurance companies, sub-advisory mandates.

business_segments.name: Digital Propositions
business_segments.description: APAC digital propositions and partnerships (Emma Pecenicic). Tokenized collateral (JPMorgan TCN). Sygnum partnership.

technology_strategy.ai_and_genai: AI for investment research, portfolio analytics, client reporting. Data-driven investment insights.
technology_strategy.digital_assets: Tokenized MMF collateral on JPMorgan Onyx/TCN (live since June 2024). Sygnum tokenization partnership. APAC digital propositions function. Benefits from Fidelity Investments ecosystem (FBTC ETF, FYOXX, FIDD stablecoin) but operates independently.
technology_strategy.platforms: Distribution platforms. Client reporting systems. Investment analytics.

operating_model.transformation: Active management differentiation in passive-dominated market. Distribution technology modernisation. APAC growth strategy. Separate from Fidelity Investments but benefits from brand/ecosystem.
operating_model.vendor_ecosystem: JPMorgan (Onyx/TCN), Sygnum Bank, HSBC (summit participation), various data and analytics providers.

analyst_judgment.strategy_posture: Active participant, not a leader. Following institutional infrastructure (JPMorgan). Benefiting from broader Fidelity ecosystem.
analyst_judgment.likely_objectives: Improve collateral efficiency. Position for tokenized fund distribution when market matures. Leverage Fidelity brand for institutional trust.
analyst_judgment.not_prioritizing: Proprietary blockchain infrastructure, stablecoin issuance, retail crypto, direct digital asset custody.
analyst_judgment.strongest_areas: Institutional trust, large MMF base, JPMorgan partnership, APAC digital propositions function.
analyst_judgment.weakest_areas: No proprietary platform. Dependent on partner infrastructure. Less visible than Fidelity Investments (US). Limited public product pipeline.
analyst_judgment.build_vs_buy_hypothesis: Partner-first. Relies on JPMorgan Onyx for tokenization. No visible proprietary technology build.
watchlist_12_months: Relationship with Fidelity Digital Assets for custody/infrastructure

process.front_office: Tokenized MMF shares available as collateral via JPMorgan TCN. Not a direct-to-investor tokenized product yet (from Fidelity International specifically).
process.middle_office: Compliance integrated through JPMorgan's regulated infrastructure. Existing fund governance applied to tokenized representations.
process.back_office: JPMorgan's Onyx blockchain for tokenization. JPMorgan's transfer agency for connectivity between fund and TCN. Near-instantaneous tokenization.
process.operating_model_maturity: Pilot to early production. TCN is live but usage scale unclear.
process.regulatory_adaptation: UK/EU regulatory context. FCA-regulated entity. Working within existing frameworks.
open_questions: Regulatory engagement on tokenization in UK/EU
Internal operating model for digital asset management
